assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: The mass spectrometer was operated in data dependent mode with the top 10 most intense multiply charged precursor ions fragmented
labeling: Coomassie-stained polyacrylamide gel slices were excised from SDS-PAGE gels
quantification: Raw mass spectrometric data was processed in MaxQuant (version 1.3.0.5) for peptide and protein identification
enrichment: Through phospho-proteomic analysis of the shelterin complex

workflow_hints: phospho-proteomic analysis of the shelterin complex
identified a putative CDK2 phosphorylation site in human TRF2 at Ser365

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment combines affinity purification (AP-MS) of the shelterin complex with phospho-proteomic analysis to identify specific phosphorylation sites (Ser365/367). While no explicit labeling reagent is mentioned, the use of gel slices and MaxQuant for identification without isobaric tags indicates a label-free (LFQ) approach.

organism: the database search was performed using the Andromeda search engine against the Homo Sapiens canonical sequences
cell_lines: 293 HEK cells stably expressing Flag-HA RTEL1, N-Flap (Flag-GFP-tagged) RTEL1, or Myc-TRF2
scope: For protein immunoprecipitation, whole-cell extracts were precleared with protein G Sepharose, and two miligrams of precleared extract from 293 HEK expressing Flag-HA RTEL1, N-Flap RTEL1, or Myc-TRF2 were incubated for 1 hour with anti-HA, anti-GFP or anti-Myc antibodies
Immunocomplexes were incubated with protein G Sepharose for 45minutes, washed 3x in NET buffer and subjected to 10% SDS-PAGE.
Coomassie-stained polyacrylamide gel slices were excised from SDS-PAGE gels using a scalpel and processed for mass spectrometry
Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: While the study uses both mouse and human cells, the mass spectrometry analysis specifically used the Homo Sapiens database and analyzed immunoprecipitated complexes from HEK 293 cells.
